test_definition.description: First real general state-update benchmark. A realistic product/inventory record contains many unchanged fields; only on-hand inventory changes.

provenance.product_metadata_source: Anker manufacturer product and support pages
provenance.note: Product metadata is manufacturer-sourced. Warehouse SKU, bin, counts, supplier record, cycle-count fields, and event are synthetic benchmark data.

notes: Lightning devices require a USB-C to Lightning cable and USB-C devices require a USB-C to USB-C cable; cables are sold separately.
Supports Super Fast Charging for Samsung S22 Ultra but not 45W Super Fast Charging 2.0.
Anker recommends USB-C ports for charging an Apple Watch.

source.new_information: At the receiving dock this afternoon, 12 units of the Anker 735 Charger, model A2667, were received and added to on-hand inventory. Later, 5 units of that same model were shipped to customers. No reservations were created or released, no purchase-order quantity changed, and no backorders were created. The inventory manager said the reorder point might be lowered to 10 next month, but no change was approved or entered today. No product metadata, supplier, bin location, cycle-count information, or lifecycle status changed.

notes: Lightning devices require a USB-C to Lightning cable and USB-C devices require a USB-C to USB-C cable; cables are sold separately.
Supports Super Fast Charging for Samsung S22 Ultra but not 45W Super Fast Charging 2.0.
Anker recommends USB-C ports for charging an Apple Watch.

calls.text:
The following state fields are established to have changed based on the new information:

- `inventory.on_hand_units`: Increased by 12 (received) and then decreased by 5 (shipped), resulting in a net change of +7 units.
- `inventory.units_on_order`: Unchanged — no purchase-order quantity was modified.
- `inventory.reserved_units`: Unchanged — no reservations were created or released.
- `inventory.reorder_point_units`: Unchanged — no change was approved or entered today, despite a discussion to lower it to 10 next month.
- `inventory.backordered`: Unchanged — no backorders were created.
- `inventory.cycle_count_status` and `inventory.last_cycle_count_date`: Unchanged — no cycle-count information was modified.
- `product.*`: Unchanged — no product metadata, safety standards, compatibility, or notes were modified.
- `inventory.supplier`, `inventory.warehouse_bin`, `inventory.discontinued`: Unchanged — no changes to supplier, bin location, or lifecycle status.

Completed events:
- 12 units received → `on_hand_units` increased by 12.
- 5 units shipped → `on_hand_units` decreased by 5.

Discussion/planned but not yet enacted:
- Reorder point may be lowered to 10 next month — not yet approved or entered.

Explicitly unchanged facts:
- No changes to `reserved_units`, `backordered`, `reorder_point_units`, `cycle_count_status`, `last_cycle_count_date`, `supplier`, `warehouse_bin`, `discontinued`, or any product metadata.

Only `inventory.on_hand_units` is confirmed to have changed as a result of completed transactions.
